over generated documents and operations.note: A removed final linked paragraph transfers its id to surviving unlinked source content.
#3007: a tracked deletion of a paragraph holding a note reference applies; Accept All removes the note with it.
A bookmark ending before a comment's end in the replaced block does not keep the comment a direct replacement of the block's words takes.
A standing note reference keeps a range when its paragraph's prose is replaced.
A reference between two comment endings does not keep the thread whose entire text was replaced.
Passing a reference between endings uses a physical gap that remains valid when both threads survive.
A thread whose entire text was replaced goes where a comment from an earlier paragraph ends first in the same paragraph.
